A missing or ambiguous value is None, never a fabricated zero. Use coerce_price and coerce_int rather than guessing. requirements.requirement: coerce_price, coerce_int and coerce_rating return None when the text is ambiguous or is not a price, count or rating, and validate_offer flags the field, instead of guessing. Prices: two numbers glued by the thousands-separator space ('1 999 2 999', '1 999 2 999 ₽', '1,999,2,999'), an inconsistent grouping or a three-digit fraction ('3 983.999'), a monthly instalment ('от 5 751 ₽/ мес.'), a saving ('выгода 5 000 ₽') and a discount ('скидка 30%') are None, while a listing's "от" price and ordinary grouped/decimal shapes stay real prices. Counts: any-script magnitude letter ('12万') or a currency glyph ('24 088₽') is None. Ratings: a non-5 denominator written as a word ('4.5 из 10') is None, and so is a thousands-grouped count ('1 299', '5 000', '12 345' with a plain, no-break U+00A0, narrow no-break U+202F or thin U+2009 space) with or without letters, while letter-free comma text keeps its old reading. Amendment (2026-11-01 review follow-up) closes three cases the guards missed: the non-price word guard is the one shared DECOY_MARKERS list (moved into resilience.py, from which the DOM decoy regex is generated), so an instalment ('Рассрочка 5 751 ₽'), a delivery-point count ('в 1356 пунктов'), loyalty points and cashback are None and price_from_texts moves on to the next candidate ('в 1356 пунктов', '58 999 ₽' gives 58999.0); a magnitude suffix right after the number is refused on the price path ('12万', '1.2万', '1.2K', '15 тыс. ₽') exactly as coerce_int refuses it; and coerce_rating's grouped-count guard takes three or more digits after the space, so '1 2999' is None too. '1 999 ₽', '1 999,50 ₽', 'от 1 999 ₽', '¥129' and '129.00' keep parsing.
requirements.rule: When a reachable payload no longer matches the expected structure, report parser_drift. Distinguish format change from transport_down, rate limits, missing products, login walls and challenge_required. Selfchecks report success, drift_detected or inconclusive; a blocked probe does not verify parser health. Shape signatures retain paths and types, not payload values; adoption differs by connector.

Use ErrorCode: auth_missing, rate_limited, timeout, transport_down, parser_drift, bad_request, permission_denied, challenge_required, not_found. Only rate_limited, timeout, transport_down and challenge_required have retryable=true. ConnectorError serializes error, message and retryable plus applicable provider, retry_after_s and status_code; raise_tool_error wraps JSON in FastMCP ToolError. ChallengeRequiredError additionally serializes requires_user_action=true, retryable_now=false, retry_when=after_user_confirmation, a concrete user_action naming the real CLI command or the retained tab, the challenge type and optional handoff metadata. Every failure site raises through raise_tool_error, never ToolError(ConnectorError(...)): str() of that form is the bare message, so the agent would lose the error code, retryable and the challenge fields and the text would bypass redaction (audit, 2026-11-01: nine AliExpress sites and both mcp_core.kit render_json refusals were of that form). A generic failure handler uses raise_tool_error_from, which passes a ConnectorError through unchanged so its code, status_code, retry_after_s and provider survive, and turns any other exception into the redacted transport_down it always was (R-ERROR-PASSTHROUGH).

Never write application diagnostics to stdout in MCP server code: stdio stdout belongs to JSON-RPC. Use log_event on stderr or FastMCP Context logging. Operator cli.py and __main__ entrypoints are excluded by the no-print guard; their human-facing output is not an MCP server diagnostic channel.

requirements.requirement: For every connector whose shape_reference declares required key families or required keys (avito, lamoda, taobao, citilink, dns, and now aliexpress, cian, detmir, megamarket, ozon, wb), the normal data path of its search tool must compare the payload against that registry through one shared mcp-core helper (resilience.shape_drift_warning) and, when a whole family vanished, carry exactly one compact warning per call in the response's existing meta warnings, of the exact form `shape_drift: SOURCE: missing FAMILY` (SOURCE names the tool that answered, FAMILY the lost alias family), flipping healthy to false. No extra network requests and no state; a complete payload costs only the comparison itself. The comparison is on family presence, not types: a null member is present, and a member below a NESTED array (not the item envelope) that the payload shows as empty on every element is present too — the signature writes an empty list as `<path>:empty_array`, and a container with no elements has no key to lose, so wb's all-delisted page ("sizes": [] on every product, the price family living at products[].sizes[].price) must not read as drift; sizes entries that exist without any price key stay drift, so do a page mixing empty and filled sizes and an empty sibling envelope (items: [] next to a filled goods[]), and the rule is the shared vacuity rule the zero-item guard already applied, not a connector-local case. Payloads with zero items do not run the check (per-item families would be vacuously absent); the citilink/dns/lamoda/taobao tools already raise on empty before it, avito/cian/megamarket guard on non-empty items, detmir/ozon guard on a non-empty parsed page, and wb returns no_results first. The guard payload is the one carrying raw keys the parser depends on: the extractor output for aliexpress (dns-style), the raw envelope for cian/detmir/megamarket/wb (their parsers emit every parsed key unconditionally, so only the raw payload can lose presence), and the parsed tile dicts for ozon (url is its only conditionally-emitted parser-critical key; title-less and sku-less tiles are dropped, price/stock loss is already loud via validate_offer and the no_items warning). For the five extractor-output connectors (aliexpress, citilink, dns, lamoda, taobao) the extractor emits every key on every tile, so the check can only lose a key when the extractor itself stops emitting it; a marketplace page that changed shape reaches the agent as empty values, which validate_items reports as no_prices_on_page or title_missing — their shape_reference headers say so. The avito registry accepts all three envelopes _parse_search_items reads (top-level items[], catalog.items[] and data.items[]) for the id, title and price families, so a payload served only through data.items[] no longer reports every family missing while a family actually lost still warns. Yandex stays out of scope: its parser emits every item key unconditionally on every payload level and its shape_reference documents that a key-presence guard would never fire. Each of the six connectors' shape_reference also pins the parser-output search (and, where a card fixture exists, card) fingerprint over its captured fixture, and its selfcheck uses the same registry the runtime path does. Test execution stays with the lead.

requirement.source: Owner security task, 2026-11-01 (redaction as a property of the logging and error functions); owner audit follow-up, 2026-11-01 (the FastMCP error boundary)

requirements.requirement: Secret redaction is a property of the shared logging and error functions, not caller discipline. log_event redacts every string it emits — the event name and every string in field values, including strings nested in lists/dicts — before serializing the JSON event; raise_tool_error redacts the ToolError message and every string field of the serialized ConnectorError. Both use mcp-core's redact_error_text rules, which include the secret environment-variable value rule (R-SECRET-ENV-VALUES). Existing explicit _redact wrappers stay and are harmless because redaction is idempotent. Non-string values pass through unchanged, never coerced to text. The server boundary is the third property: run_server installs ToolErrorRedactionMiddleware on every transport (stdio and HTTP), and that middleware re-raises a ToolError whose text changes under redact_error_text with the redacted text, keeping __cause__, while passing every other exception and every unchanged message through untouched — so the ToolError FastMCP builds itself from an unexpected exception (its "Error calling tool ...: {e}" boundary) cannot carry a credential out, even when the exception comes from code outside a tool's own try, as build_client does in yandex and detmir. The boundary redacts without truncating: max_len is the text's own length, so an already-redacted JSON ToolError survives byte-identical and a long message is never cut into unparseable JSON. Response fields that quote an upstream body (Ozon reviews last_error) and client-facing debug logs (Ozon's Tier-1 ctx.debug) use the same rules (audit, 2026-11-01).

Values are read from os.environ at redaction time, not import time, so a value set later is still covered; empty values, values shorter than 6 characters and values occurring inside the <redacted> placeholder are ignored, and when one value contains another the longer one is replaced first. The replacement is plain string replacement (no per-call regex), runs before the shape rules and the 500-character cap, and is idempotent. Proxy env vars are not in the registry: their credential part is covered by the URL userinfo rule and their host is deliberately kept readable.

requirement.source: Outside-in study 2026-11-02, remaining-check R15: a raw CDP command's timeout restarted on every unrelated event

requirements.requirement: A raw CDP command has an absolute deadline, not an inactivity limit. CDP broadcasts every event to every attached client, so a per-receive timeout restarts on each foreign event and a silent socket can answer minutes later. The deadline is set once, before the command goes out, and every wait uses only the time that is left; the same rule covers the attach commands (Target.createTarget, Page.enable, Network.enable, Runtime.enable) and the owned-target cleanup, not only evaluate. Foreign events are still read and noted, so a frame URL that arrives while the command waits is not lost, and a matching response still correlates with its command. Outbound websocket.send consumes the same absolute deadline; backpressure must not leave attach commands waiting beyond it, and timed-out operations exit their owning connection/target context (prepublication review, 2026-11-03).

The PyPI bundle carries the source packages, the README and the LICENSE — not the root scripts and docs — so an installed package may not point at `scripts/start_chrome_cdp.ps1`, `scripts/diagnose_drift.py` or `docs/ANTI_BOT.md`. The hint follows the install mode: a checkout names the local scripts and docs and the documented `uv run marketplace-mcp` spelling; a wheel install names the console script the bundle installs; a uvx run names the pinned `uvx ru-marketplace-mcp@<version>` release. Every link a hint carries is pinned to the release's tag and points at a file of that release. A dry run changes no configuration.

requirement.source: Outside-in study 2026-11-02, remaining-check R20: a HandoffBusyError became a generic transport_down without its fields

requirements.requirement: A generic failure handler passes a ConnectorError through unchanged, so the machine fields a caller acts on survive: a busy browser handoff keeps status_code 409 and its retry_after_s, a full retained-page registry keeps its own reason, a deadline keeps the timeout code and its provider. Every connector's search, card, review and selfcheck handler uses the shared path (raise_tool_error_from), and the fields reach the caller both through the native source tool and through compare's per-source outcome. An unexpected failure stays the redacted transport_down it always was: it invents no taxonomy and leaks no credential.

requirement.source: Outside-in study 2026-11-02, remaining-check R05: a display text became a plausible-but-wrong count

requirements.requirement: A counter that a marketplace renders as display text is parsed once, in one shared place: the known review label is split off and the NUMBER is then parsed strictly. A grouped count ("1 200", "1200", "24 086 отзывов") keeps its real value. A sign, a range, two numbers and a magnitude form ("1.2K", "2 тыс.") name no single count and are refused — None, never a manufactured integer. The native parser and the comparison adapter use the same helper, so a count cannot be right on one side and wrong on the other.

requirement.source: Outside-in study 2026-11-02, remaining-check R06: count was the parsed total while items carried the first thirty

requirements.requirement: A search answer publishes count as the number of items it returns (count == len(items)), and names the parsed total separately (parsed_count) with a truncated flag. More parsed than returned is said out loud: the answer carries a truncation warning, and the health check runs on exactly the items the agent receives. A complete short answer is complete: no truncation warning and no damage.

requirement.source: Outside-in study 2026-11-02, remaining-check R10: batch bounds and closed enums were prose only

requirements.requirement: A limit a tool enforces is a limit its schema states: the batch size, the positivity of the batch items and a closed set of values live in the tool signature, so tools/list carries them and a call that breaks them is refused by the schema before any request goes out. The server-side checks and their clear errors stay, and the valid boundary values still run.

requirement.source: Outside-in study 2026-11-02, remaining-check R11: the inventory did not list WB while wb_search used CDP

requirements.requirement: The source inventory separates three questions: does a source REQUIRE the browser, MAY it use one, and which route will it take now. The answers follow the source's configured mode, so Wildberries in DOM mode and Wildberries with the DOM fallback on are listed as browser-backed, while Wildberries in API-only mode is not. Answering them opens no browser and spends no navigation.

requirement.source: Outside-in study 2026-11-02, remaining-check R18: twelve diagnostics arrived as ten without a word

requirements.requirement: A bounded list of diagnostics stays bounded and says what it left out: the delivery names the number of suppressed diagnostics, through the native tool and through the comparison. A diagnostic that explains an unhealthy answer is never dropped behind an informational note, and the health verdict is computed from the full list, so a cut list cannot turn an unhealthy answer into a healthy one.
